infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NyaySetu photographs evidence at the scene. The image is hashed on this device before it is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NyaySetu lets you attach an existing photograph as evidence.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Evidence and bail check-ins are recorded with the coordinates where they happened, which is what the court verifies.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NyaySetu records sound with search and seizure video, so the recording is complete.
